  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

* Plan options that bundle vision and hearing, too
* Coverage costs pennies a day
* Shop online anytime, 24/7/365

* Available for shopping during Open Enrollment (Nov 1 - Dec 15, in most states)

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

    cancer and specialty care.

    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Pharmacy Services ][128]

[A medical professional in blue scrubs examines a brain scan image.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Who we are

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

## Welcome to Active Care Center

#### About us

We have been treating patients with musculoskeletal injuries and ailments since 2002. We pride
ourselves on our approach to diagnosis and treatment. Reaching the correct diagnosis is paramount in
each case as it determines the appropriate course of treatment. Whether an advanced in-clinic
orthopedic examination, in-house NCV/EMG nerve study, or further referral for MRI evaluation is in
order, no patient treatment starts before we are sure of what we are treating.  



To treat your pain, we may utilize standard chiropractic manipulative medicine, advanced MLS Laser
Therapy, nutritional counseling, or acupuncture; in many cases, physical therapy exercises, manual
therapy, or a strengthening program may be necessary. The combinations and approaches are many, but
the goal is only one – to get you back to optimum health.



We also offer unique services to the Transportation Industry; our clinic is certified by the FMCSA
to perform DOT Medical Testing, drug testing, and random alcohol testing.  We work with various
Transport and Logistics companies as well as Truck Driving Schools.

* Sprains and strains
* Automobile crash and Whiplash injuries
* Post-surgical rehabilitation
* Scoliosis
* Plantar fasciitis and heel pain
* Knee and Hip osteoarthritis
* Muscle pain
* Carpal tunnel syndrome and other neuropathies

## Medical Services

#### Chiropractic Medicine

Using safe and gentle joint manipulation, we can decrease pain, increase the range of motion, and
improve the functioning of the neck, back, and extremities.  In conjunction with knowledge of modern
medicine, orthopedics, neurology, and internal medicine, Chiropractors can non-invasively relieve
pain and return the patient to full health, unlike any other medical specialty. We are particularly
proud of our high success rate in the treatment of back and neck pain.

#### Non-invasive Orthopedics

Our clinic’s focus on the diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal ailments stems from our
clinical director’s passion and great interest in chiropractic orthopedics, physical therapy, and
rehabilitation. 

 Dr. Albert Pawlusiewicz is a Board Certified Chiropractic Orthopedist, who has dedicated his career
to non-invasive treatment of orthopedic, sports, and post-trauma injuries.  Orthopedics does not
have to mean surgery; in fact, over 99% of all orthopedic cases we see are never treated surgically.
 

#### Physical Therapy

At Active Care Center, the paramount focus is centered on "*functional* *rehabilitation"* of our
patients.  This means that the therapists not only focus on improvements in range of motion or
strength itself but primarily look at how these improvements translate to the ability to perform all
home, leisure, and work tasks.  It is imperative to know how the injury affects the patient's daily
activities and set therapy goals accordingly to restore his or her ability to perform these tasks
after therapy.

#### Acupuncture

Acupuncture is used at our clinic as an adjunct therapy method in treating painful conditions,
especially those that incapacitate the patient to such an extent that physical therapy and manual
therapy cannot be initially utilized.  We also use needling in difficult or therapy-resistant
conditions such as frozen shoulder or sciatica.  The decision to use acupuncture is made on a case
by case basis and depends on the ailment, its chronicity, and best medical practice.

#### Injury Management

At Active Care Center the injured person, be it from a car, work, or other injury, will find a
dedicated team of providers who will objectively evaluate the injury, make specific recommendations,
and initiate treatment of the injury. Additionally, we help our patients to file a claim with a
responsible party as many patients are too emotionally distraught or do not know how to deal with
the insurance situation, and what steps to take to get their health back without worrying about
finances.

#### Post-surgical rehabilitation

For many illnesses and injuries, surgery is often a necessary solution.  Post-surgical
rehabilitation is a key factor in successful recovery. Physical therapy can aid the healing process
through reduction of initial swelling, improving range of motion, and regaining of strength,  The
end goal is to return the patient to full and pain-free daily home and work activities. Our Physical
Therapists follow strict guidelines and protocols to ensure gradual improvement without risking
injuring the delicate, healing tissue.

#### Neurodiagnostic Testing

 NCV is often used along with an EMG to tell the difference between a nerve disorder and a muscle
disorder. NCV detects a problem with the nerve, whereas an EMG detects whether the muscle is working
properly in response to the nerve's stimulus.  Nerve conduction studies may also be done to find the
cause of symptoms, such as numbness, tingling, and continuous pain. It is used to help diagnose such
common diseases as sciatica, carpal tunnel syndrom,e or chronic neuropathy.

#### Laser Therapy Pain Management

MLS Laser Therapy is a non-invasive, safe, and effective treatment modality where light is used to
relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing and soft tissue repair. Our laser is
the only multi-wave locked system, dual wave, fully robotic laser therapy system on the market. This
means deeper penetration with no heat produced allowing faster healing with no known side effects.
It has been cleared by the FDA. 

[Go to our dedicated laser website for more info][10]

## Occupational Medicine

#### DOT Testing

Transportation laws require many drivers and others working for the industry to be regularly
evaluated medically.  We offer DOT Medical Testing for drivers holding CDL and class C licenses, we
test bus drivers and will soon be licensed to perform pilot medical testing. We regularly perform
Drug and Alcohol testing for our drivers as well. We are part of Medstop, TeamCME, and  OOIDA.

#### Functional Capacity (FCE) Evaluations

FCE’s are ordered for many reasons: they can be ordered to evaluate a permanent disability; to
ascertain if further rehabilitation is necessary to return the worker to work; and as a second
opinion in contested workers comp cases.  We are equipped to provide answers in all cases through
objective functional testing.   Our physical therapy clinic has partnered with OccuPro, a national
leader in research and occupational injury evaluation, and uses OccuPro’s advanced software to
provide FCE evaluations. 

#### Work Injury Management

On-job-site injuries cost enormous amounts of lost time, money, and productivity.  Being an
orthopedic and rehabilitation facility we are well equipped to deal with treatment of these
injuries.  We will manage the initial injury and guide the patient through physical therapy, work
conditioning, and Fit-for-Duty evaluations. We will file all necessary reports with Worker Comp and
communicate with case managers.  We will ensure that the patient's case is completed and that he or
she can safely return to work.  

#### Employer Services

Many employers secure our services for testing of their employees.  This is done to ensure safety at
the workplace and prevent needless liability exposure. We offer: Ergonomic Site Evaluations,
Fit-For-Duty Evaluations, Pre-Placement Evaluations, Post-Offer Employment Evaluations, Drug and
Alcohol Testing, and DOT Medical testing.  Please contact us how can we help you to improve
work-site safety and ergonomics.

## Medical Services

#### Chiropractic Medicine

Using safe and gentle joint manipulation, we can decrease pain, increase the range of motion, and
improve the functioning of the neck, back, and extremities.  In conjunction with knowledge of modern
medicine, orthopedics, neurology, and internal medicine, Chiropractors can non-invasively relieve
pain and return the patient to full health, unlike any other medical specialty. We are particularly
proud of our high success rate in the treatment of back and neck pain.

#### Non-invasive Orthopedics

Our clinic’s focus on the diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal ailments stems from our
clinical director’s passion and great interest in chiropractic orthopedics, physical therapy, and
rehabilitation. 

 Dr. Albert Pawlusiewicz is a Board Certified Chiropractic Orthopedist, who has dedicated his career
to non-invasive treatment of orthopedic, sports, and post-trauma injuries.  Orthopedics does not
have to mean surgery; in fact, over 99% of all orthopedic cases we see are never treated surgically.
 

#### Physical Therapy

At Active Care Center, the paramount focus is centered on "*functional* *rehabilitation"* of our
patients.  This means that the therapists not only focus on improvements in range of motion or
strength itself but primarily look at how these improvements translate to the ability to perform all
home, leisure, and work tasks.  It is imperative to know how the injury affects the patient's daily
activities and set therapy goals accordingly to restore his or her ability to perform these tasks
after therapy.

#### Acupuncture

Acupuncture is used at our clinic as an adjunct therapy method in treating painful conditions,
especially those that incapacitate the patient to such an extent that physical therapy and manual
therapy cannot be initially utilized.  We also use needling in difficult or therapy-resistant
conditions such as frozen shoulder or sciatica.  The decision to use acupuncture is made on a case
by case basis and depends on the ailment, its chronicity, and best medical practice.

#### Injury Management

At Active Care Center the injured person, be it from a car, work, or other injury, will find a
dedicated team of providers who will objectively evaluate the injury, make specific recommendations,
and initiate treatment of the injury. Additionally, we help our patients to file a claim with a
responsible party as many patients are too emotionally distraught or do not know how to deal with
the insurance situation, and what steps to take to get their health back without worrying about
finances.

#### Post-surgical rehabilitation

For many illnesses and injuries, surgery is often a necessary solution.  Post-surgical
rehabilitation is a key factor in successful recovery. Physical therapy can aid the healing process
through reduction of initial swelling, improving range of motion, and regaining of strength,  The
end goal is to return the patient to full and pain-free daily home and work activities. Our Physical
Therapists follow strict guidelines and protocols to ensure gradual improvement without risking
injuring the delicate, healing tissue.

#### Neurodiagnostic Testing

 NCV is often used along with an EMG to tell the difference between a nerve disorder and a muscle
disorder. NCV detects a problem with the nerve, whereas an EMG detects whether the muscle is working
properly in response to the nerve's stimulus.  Nerve conduction studies may also be done to find the
cause of symptoms, such as numbness, tingling, and continuous pain. It is used to help diagnose such
common diseases as sciatica, carpal tunnel syndrom,e or chronic neuropathy.

#### Laser Therapy Pain Management

MLS Laser Therapy is a non-invasive, safe, and effective treatment modality where light is used to
relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing and soft tissue repair. Our laser is
the only multi-wave locked system, dual wave, fully robotic laser therapy system on the market. This
means deeper penetration with no heat produced allowing faster healing with no known side effects.
It has been cleared by the FDA. 

[Go to our dedicated laser website for more info][10]

## Occupational Medicine

#### DOT Testing

Transportation laws require many drivers and others working for the industry to be regularly
evaluated medically.  We offer DOT Medical Testing for drivers holding CDL and class C licenses, we
test bus drivers and will soon be licensed to perform pilot medical testing. We regularly perform
Drug and Alcohol testing for our drivers as well. We are part of Medstop, TeamCME, and  OOIDA.

#### Functional Capacity (FCE) Evaluations

FCE’s are ordered for many reasons: they can be ordered to evaluate a permanent disability; to
ascertain if further rehabilitation is necessary to return the worker to work; and as a second
opinion in contested workers comp cases.  We are equipped to provide answers in all cases through
objective functional testing.   Our physical therapy clinic has partnered with OccuPro, a national
leader in research and occupational injury evaluation, and uses OccuPro’s advanced software to
provide FCE evaluations. 

#### Work Injury Management

On-job-site injuries cost enormous amounts of lost time, money, and productivity.  Being an
orthopedic and rehabilitation facility we are well equipped to deal with treatment of these
injuries.  We will manage the initial injury and guide the patient through physical therapy, work
conditioning, and Fit-for-Duty evaluations. We will file all necessary reports with Worker Comp and
communicate with case managers.  We will ensure that the patient's case is completed and that he or
she can safely return to work.  

#### Employer Services

Many employers secure our services for testing of their employees.  This is done to ensure safety at
the workplace and prevent needless liability exposure. We offer: Ergonomic Site Evaluations,
Fit-For-Duty Evaluations, Pre-Placement Evaluations, Post-Offer Employment Evaluations, Drug and
Alcohol Testing, and DOT Medical testing.  Please contact us how can we help you to improve
work-site safety and ergonomics.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

day and everywhere.

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

day and everywhere.

lasting value for the communities we serve.

is possible in healthcare.

innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine in the Gold Coast neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois is
a practice providing their patients with exceptional integrative and holistic women’s health care.
Doctors Hoyer and Skul met in medical school and have practiced together ever since. After
practicing academic medicine at Rush University Medical Center since the mid-80's, they opened their
medical practice – Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine in 2001. Committed to each other
and the common goal of patient-centered care, they designed a healthcare environment different from
the customary doctor’s office.

At Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine, the team understands that seeing the doctor is only
one part of your medical experience. They have a dedicated, highly trained, knowledgeable and
friendly staff to help them provide a warm, family-like atmosphere for their patients.

The Center’s expertise is in primary women’s health care. The physicians are board-certified in
Internal Medicine and Anti-Aging and Regenerative Medicine. They espouse a philosophy of
patient-centered care, approaching each patient compassionately and supporting them through their
health journey. They emphasize preventive care, patient education and lifestyle change and partner
with their patients to facilitate the best medical decision making. This ultimately leads to optimum
outcomes.

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine also serves the needs of male patients, often referred by
their mothers, sisters and significant others. Patients come from a variety of ethnic backgrounds,
span ages from adolescence to senescence and often include several generations of the same family.

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine doctors have been recognized as Chicago’s and America’s
Top Doctors year after year. Dr. Skul and Dr. Hoyer have been among the "Best Doctors for Women in
Chicago," “Top Primary Care Doctors in Chicago,” and "Top Doctors in Chicago" as reported by Chicago
Magazine. They also continue to be named "The Nation's Top Doctors" by US News. They were also
ranked as Chicago Super Doctors, won the Super Service Award for Internal Medicine from Angie's
List, and have been selected as Castle Connolly's Exceptional Women in Medicine for 2019.

Call or book an appointment online with Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine today.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

precise, personal, and connected - and build integrated solutions to help solve for the industry's

empowering clinicians to make therapies more accurate and effective.

[Contract Manufacturing (OEM) - Gesco Healthcare]

## Contract Manufacturing (OEM)

GESCO Healthcare is dedicated to working with medical equipment manufacturer and suppliers around
the world to develop and manufacture innovative, value added, quality products and solutions.

GESCO Healthcare offers a wide range of [surgical instruments][32] used for orthopaedic and spinal
procedures. Our skilled team develops the products to our clients’ exact requirements, whether you
require a modification of an existing instrument or an entirely new design at competitive prices,
designing them after developing operational prototypes that ensure quality control at every stage.

[ Read More  ][33]

## Transforming Lives Every Day

Gesco Healthcare is an award-winning medical equipment manufacturer, transforming lives of millions
across the globe. We design, develop and manufacture innovative medical devices and pathbreaking
solutions that help improve global health. Our wide-ranging catalog includes superior-quality,
innovative and precise surgical instruments and spinal, orthopedic and CMF implants, designed in
close colloration with the medical fraternity.

* We offer a range of home health care services, including Chronic Disease Management, Medication
  Teaching and Management, Post-Surgical Care, Pain Management, and other individualized support to
  help clients recover and maintain health in the comfort of their own home.

##### 2. How do I schedule an assessment or start services?
* You can contact us by phone or email to request a free in-home assessment. Our team will guide you
  through the process, evaluate your needs, and create a personalized care plan.

##### 3. Is home health care covered by insurance?
* Coverage depends on your individual insurance plan. Please contact us to verify coverage. We
  accept a variety of insurance providers and can help you understand your benefits.

##### 4. Where do you provide services?
* We serve clients throughout Massachusetts, including Springfield and surrounding communities,
  delivering care in homes and approved locations.

##### 5. How are care plans developed?
* After an initial assessment, our clinical team designs a customized care plan that addresses your
  medical, emotional, and daily living needs. Plans are regularly updated to reflect changing needs.

##### 6. Who provides the care?
* Our skilled caregivers and licensed healthcare professionals are trained to deliver compassionate,
  consistent, and safe care, tailored to each client’s individual requirements.

few helpful articles or learn more about senior wellness support in Montclair, NJ, before they do
anything else. Start wherever feels comfortable and go at your own pace.

### How do I get started at HealthySeventy?

Start with whatever feels easiest. Look through the services, spend some time with the resources, or
reach out directly if you want more personal help. We will help you figure out what makes sense for
your situation without making the process feel like a big deal.

# Restore Movement.
# Reclaim Confidence.
# Elevate Your Life.

At Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness, we identify and correct the root cause of dysfunction—helping you
heal naturally and perform at your highest level without drugs or surgery.
[Book An Appointment][11]
[Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness]


## Root-Cause Diagnostics

We utilize detailed movement-based exams to pinpoint and treat the true source of your pain.



## Customized Care

Your goals drive our strategy. We create non-invasive approaches that restore function, optimize
performance, and support your long-term health.


## Advanced Laser Therapy

We provide state-of-the-art Class IV technology to accelerate deep tissue repair and healing.

[green-dot]

## About Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness

At Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness, our standard is simple: care for every patient like family. That
means no sales tactics, no gimmicks, and no hidden fees — just evidence-informed chiropractic care,
outstanding service, and full transparency every step of the way.
[Learn More][12]
[Happy family having fun times at home]
[green-dot]

## Our Services

We offer a comprehensive suite of therapies designed to work in harmony, reducing inflammation and
restoring proper movement patterns for long-term health.



### Chiropractic Care

Optimal spinal function supports a more adaptable, efficient nervous system. By restoring proper
joint motion and reducing mechanical stress, we help your brain and body communicate more
effectively—allowing you to move better, recover faster, and function at your highest level.


### Class IV Laser Therapy

Experience advanced, non-invasive treatment designed to accelerate healing and reduce pain at the
cellular level. Our Aspen Class IV Laser increases circulation, decreases inflammation, and
stimulates tissue repair—helping you recover faster and get back to doing what you love.


### Massage Therapy

Our licensed therapists provide customized soft tissue care that complements chiropractic
adjustments, decreasing muscle tension and improving mobility.

[green-dot]

## Success Stories

“I truly can not say enough good things about this place. it has definitely been a 5 star
experience, I would and have recommended them to friends and family”
“Every visit has been nothing short of exceptional and I am so thankful to everyone there!”
“I started my care here 6 months ago, I had been struggling with persistent migraines for years, and
nothing seemed to help, after many doctor vists, I was told to try a chiropractor”

# Restore Movement.
# Reclaim Confidence.
# Elevate Your Life.

At Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness, we identify and correct the root cause of dysfunction—helping you
heal naturally and perform at your highest level without drugs or surgery.
[Book An Appointment][11]
[Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness]


## Root-Cause Diagnostics

We utilize detailed movement-based exams to pinpoint and treat the true source of your pain.



## Customized Care

Your goals drive our strategy. We create non-invasive approaches that restore function, optimize
performance, and support your long-term health.


## Advanced Laser Therapy

We provide state-of-the-art Class IV technology to accelerate deep tissue repair and healing.

[green-dot]

## About Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness

At Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness, our standard is simple: care for every patient like family. That
means no sales tactics, no gimmicks, and no hidden fees — just evidence-informed chiropractic care,
outstanding service, and full transparency every step of the way.
[Learn More][12]
[Happy family having fun times at home]
[green-dot]

## Our Services

We offer a comprehensive suite of therapies designed to work in harmony, reducing inflammation and
restoring proper movement patterns for long-term health.



### Chiropractic Care

Optimal spinal function supports a more adaptable, efficient nervous system. By restoring proper
joint motion and reducing mechanical stress, we help your brain and body communicate more
effectively—allowing you to move better, recover faster, and function at your highest level.


### Class IV Laser Therapy

Experience advanced, non-invasive treatment designed to accelerate healing and reduce pain at the
cellular level. Our Aspen Class IV Laser increases circulation, decreases inflammation, and
stimulates tissue repair—helping you recover faster and get back to doing what you love.


### Massage Therapy

Our licensed therapists provide customized soft tissue care that complements chiropractic
adjustments, decreasing muscle tension and improving mobility.

[green-dot]

## Success Stories

“I truly can not say enough good things about this place. it has definitely been a 5 star
experience, I would and have recommended them to friends and family”
“Every visit has been nothing short of exceptional and I am so thankful to everyone there!”
“I started my care here 6 months ago, I had been struggling with persistent migraines for years, and
nothing seemed to help, after many doctor vists, I was told to try a chiropractor”

What if you could work with a home-grown company that has your loved ones’ best interests at heart?
Our goal – no matter what – is to make sure you walk away with the peace of mind that comes from
knowing you’ve purchased the best possible product to keep them happy, healthy, and safe.

## **Visit our showrooms**

It’s hard to shop online when you don’t know exactly what you’re looking for. We invite you to visit
one of our three showrooms to explore the possibilities!

Our super-savvy team members can help you figure out the equipment that best meets your needs.

You’ll feel a huge sense of relief when you buy the right equipment with confidence. (Knowing that
you’ve found the perfect way to protect and care for your loved one is priceless.)

# Walk out the door knowing you got it right

With two showrooms in Fort Wayne and one in Auburn, we invite you to stop in to see – or try! –
anything we have in stock. We’ll help you figure out the best solutions for your loved one,
providing the kind of honest insight and helpful tips you’d get from a lifelong friend.

## Living with short- or long-term physical limitations can be tough – but the right home medical
## equipment can go a long way toward maintaining safety and comfort.

[View Products][18]
[View Services][19]

## **Lift Chairs**

Safely transition from sleeping, sitting, and standing positions with the help of motorized lift
chairs.

## **Stair Lifts**

Easily navigate stairs with motoriized lift chairs that operate using a mounted rail.

## **Walking aids**

Choose from our selection of crutches, canes, folding canes, walkers, rollators, and more!

## **Wheelchairs**

Maintain independence, safety and comfort with our selection of manual and power wheelchairs.

## **Compression Socks**

Improve circulation, reduce swelling, and decrease the likelihood of venous disorders.

## **Bathroom Equipment**

Limit bathroom falls with raised toilet seats, safety rails, transfer benches, and more.

## **Hospital beds**

Adjustable hospital beds can be extremely helpful to patients and caregivers alike

## **Vehicle Lifts + Hitches**

Outfit your vehicle with the equipment needed to transport wheelchairs, scooters, and more.

# FAQs

## Answers to some of our most frequently-asked questions …

#### How quickly can you deliver?

Most items can be delivered to your home within 48 hours, and if you have an immediate need, we’ll
do our best to provide expedited service.

#### Where do you deliver?

We deliver products within a 60-mile radius of Fort Wayne, IN.

#### How does your 24-hour on-call service work?

If you have an urgent need with your equipment that occurs outside of normal business hours
(particularly with hospital beds, stair lifts, and lift chairs), please call us at (260) 423-9571.
We will send a technician to your home right away

#### Do you service and clean equipment?

Sure thing! We can give your equipment a tune-up (and a good scrub!) if needed.

#### I need to have my equipment serviced. Do you offer loaners?

Yes we do! We’ll do our best to accommodate your needs, depending on availability.

#### What’s your return policy?

Items can be returned within 5 days, provided they are in new condition.

#### Do you have a showroom?

## Raise your hand if the process of or shopping for home medical equipment makes you feel like

# **HOME CARE EQUIPMENT** *Experts at your service*

What if you could work with a home-grown company that has your loved ones’ best interests at heart?
Our goal – no matter what – is to make sure you walk away with the peace of mind that comes from
knowing you’ve purchased the best possible product to keep them happy, healthy, and safe.

## **Visit our showrooms**

It’s hard to shop online when you don’t know exactly what you’re looking for. We invite you to visit
one of our three showrooms to explore the possibilities!

## **Cut to the chase**

Our super-savvy team members can help you figure out the equipment that best meets your needs.
(Exhale. Frustrating Google searches are a thing of the past!)

## Feel good about your decision

You’ll feel a huge sense of relief when you buy the right equipment with confidence. (Knowing that
you’ve found the perfect way to protect and care for your loved one is priceless.)

# Walk out the door knowing you got it right

With two showrooms in Fort Wayne and one in Auburn, we invite you to stop in to see – or try! –
anything we have in stock. We’ll help you figure out the best solutions for your loved one,
providing the kind of honest insight and helpful tips you’d get from a lifelong friend.

## Living with short- or long-term physical limitations can be tough – but the right home medical
## equipment can go a long way toward maintaining safety and comfort.

[View Services][19]

Safely transition from sleeping, sitting, and standing positions with the help of motorized lift
chairs.

## **Stair Lifts**

Easily navigate stairs with motoriized lift chairs that operate using a mounted rail.

## **Walking aids**

Choose from our selection of crutches, canes, folding canes, walkers, rollators, and more!

## **Wheelchairs**

Maintain independence, safety and comfort with our selection of manual and power wheelchairs.

## **Compression Socks**

Improve circulation, reduce swelling, and decrease the likelihood of venous disorders.

## **Bathroom Equipment**

Limit bathroom falls with raised toilet seats, safety rails, transfer benches, and more.

## **Hospital beds**

Adjustable hospital beds can be extremely helpful to patients and caregivers alike

## **Vehicle Lifts + Hitches**

Outfit your vehicle with the equipment needed to transport wheelchairs, scooters, and more.

your new equipment so you can focus on what matters most: caring for your loved one. And, if you

# We love happy customers

## See what people are saying about James Medical

# Here's How It Works...

## **Speak With An Expert**

Stop by one of our two locations (or give us a call!) to chat with someone about your specific
needs. We’ll gladly point you toward the equipment that best meets your needs..

## **Choose The Right Product**

We’ll walk you through the pros and cons of the items you’re considering, giving you straightforward
information to guide your buying decision. (No pressure … the decision is yours!)

## **Enjoy Delivery + Professional Setup**

(Frustrating) assembly NOT required! We’ll deliver the product you’ve chosen, often as soon as the
same day! We’ll help you set it up, and we’ll make sure you know exactly how to use it.

## **Get Follow-up Support + Service**

Having trouble with your equipment? We’ll fix it, and we’ll give you loaner equipment while your
product is here for repair. We also offer 24-hour on-call emergency service.

At James Medical, we know you care deeply about your parent, grandparent, or loved one, and you’re
committed to serving them in the best way you know how.

You need to partner with someone who understands your struggles and can provide straightforward and
honest input, ultimately allowing you to feel confident in your decisions.

Ultimately, taking care of aging parents and grandparents shouldn’t be so hard. We’ve been serving
Fort Wayne families for nearly 50 years, and we look forward to continuing that tradition for years
to come.

# FAQs

## Answers to some of our most frequently-asked questions …

#### How quickly can you deliver?

Most items can be delivered to your home within 48 hours, and if you have an immediate need, we’ll
do our best to provide expedited service.

#### Where do you deliver?

We deliver products within a 60-mile radius of Fort Wayne, IN.

#### How does your 24-hour on-call service work?

If you have an urgent need with your equipment that occurs outside of normal business hours
(particularly with hospital beds, stair lifts, and lift chairs), please call us at (260) 423-9571.
We will send a technician to your home right away

#### Do you service and clean equipment?

Sure thing! We can give your equipment a tune-up (and a good scrub!) if needed.

#### I need to have my equipment serviced. Do you offer loaners?

Yes we do! We’ll do our best to accommodate your needs, depending on availability.

#### What’s your return policy?

Items can be returned within 5 days, provided they are in new condition.

#### Do you have a showroom?

Yes, we have two! We invite you to visit us at 7821 Coldwater Road or 7107 W. Jefferson Blvd. in
Fort Wayne.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What services does Maywell Health provide?

Maywell Health offers a variety of services, including: 
* Pain Management 
* Nutrition Services 
* Behavioral Health Support 
* We also make referrals to Physical Therapists, Acupuncturists, Chiropractors, and other relevant
  specialists. 

How do you approach pain management?

The practice utilizes a biopsychosocial model to assess how pain impacts patients’ lives. This
allows for personalized treatment plans that align with each patient’s goals, ensuring a holistic
approach to pain management. 

What conditions can you treat?

Maywell Health specializes in managing various pain conditions, including – 
* Chronic Pain 
* Arthritis 
* Back Pain 
* Neck Pain 
* Headaches 
* Fibromyalgia 
* Sports Injuries 

Our holistic approach allows them to address both physical and psychological aspects of pain. 

How do you incorporate behavioral health into pain management?

Maywell Health recognizes that mental well-being is essential for physical health. Our behavioral
health services offer personalized care and support to help patients navigate life’s challenges,
enhancing resilience and coping strategies. 

What complementary therapies do you provide?

Maywell Health integrates various complementary therapies, including acupuncture, physical therapy,
chiropractic care, and psychotherapy, to enhance pain management and overall well-being. 

What should I expect during my first visit?

During your first visit, you can expect a comprehensive assessment of your pain and its impact on
your life. Dr. Mayrsohn and his team will discuss your health goals and collaboratively develop a
personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs. 

How often will I need to visit for treatment?

The frequency of visits will depend on your individual treatment plan and progress. After your
initial assessment, your healthcare provider will recommend a tailored schedule that aligns with
your goals. 

Can I continue my current medications while receiving treatment?

Yes, you can typically continue your current medications while undergoing treatment at Maywell
Health. However, it’s essential to discuss all medications with your healthcare provider to ensure
safe and effective pain management. 

Do you have experience with Workers’ Compensation?

Yes, [we’ve worked extensively with individuals who have been injured at work][194]. Please call if
you want to discuss your specific case and learn more about how we can guide you through this
challenging time in your life.

effectively blends the best of cutting-edge clinical medicine with complementary therapies such as

## Frequently Asked Questions

What services does Maywell Health provide?

Maywell Health offers a variety of services, including: 
* Pain Management 
* Nutrition Services 
* Behavioral Health Support 
* We also make referrals to Physical Therapists, Acupuncturists, Chiropractors, and other relevant
  specialists. 

How do you approach pain management?

The practice utilizes a biopsychosocial model to assess how pain impacts patients’ lives. This
allows for personalized treatment plans that align with each patient’s goals, ensuring a holistic
approach to pain management. 

What conditions can you treat?

Maywell Health specializes in managing various pain conditions, including – 
* Chronic Pain 
* Arthritis 
* Back Pain 
* Neck Pain 
* Headaches 
* Fibromyalgia 
* Sports Injuries 

Our holistic approach allows them to address both physical and psychological aspects of pain. 

How do you incorporate behavioral health into pain management?

Maywell Health recognizes that mental well-being is essential for physical health. Our behavioral
health services offer personalized care and support to help patients navigate life’s challenges,
enhancing resilience and coping strategies. 

What complementary therapies do you provide?

Maywell Health integrates various complementary therapies, including acupuncture, physical therapy,
chiropractic care, and psychotherapy, to enhance pain management and overall well-being. 

What should I expect during my first visit?

During your first visit, you can expect a comprehensive assessment of your pain and its impact on
your life. Dr. Mayrsohn and his team will discuss your health goals and collaboratively develop a
personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs. 

How often will I need to visit for treatment?

The frequency of visits will depend on your individual treatment plan and progress. After your
initial assessment, your healthcare provider will recommend a tailored schedule that aligns with
your goals. 

Can I continue my current medications while receiving treatment?

Yes, you can typically continue your current medications while undergoing treatment at Maywell
Health. However, it’s essential to discuss all medications with your healthcare provider to ensure
safe and effective pain management. 

Do you have experience with Workers’ Compensation?

Yes, [we’ve worked extensively with individuals who have been injured at work][194]. Please call if
you want to discuss your specific case and learn more about how we can guide you through this
challenging time in your life.

# Your *innovation*, brought to life by our *expertise*.

We're a specialist MedTech contract research organisation (CRO) with clinical trial expertise across
Australia, New Zealand, and the USA. We help innovators move from the bench to the market with
connected strategy, execution, and regulatory support.

[Get In Touch][16]

## Choose the pathway for you

[

### Startups

## Trusted by MedTech innovators worldwide

Mobius is an ISO 9001-certified, founder-led CRO helping innovators secure clinical and regulatory
success
18
years of operational expertise
27+
therapeutic areas of experience
140+
successful trials, including 100+ in medical devices
10+
years of ISO 9001-certified quality management systems

## Advancing world-first breakthroughs, faster

World first breakthroughs aren't designed to sit on the lab bench forever. They need to be in the
hands of doctors and patients - saving lives and transforming outcomes. We help you get there.

### Tailored services

Clinical and regulatory strategies that adapt to your pathway

### Full-service model

Clinician-led expertise plus strategic partners, from pre-clinical to post-market.

### Global standards

Compliance with FDA, EMA, TGA, and other regulatory bodies

## The Mobius difference

Medical innovations are not one-size-fits-all, so why should your clinical trials be? At Mobius, our
team uses their deep expertise to develop a clinical trial strategy tailored for you.

### Traditional CRO

Rigid processes
Highly structured with little room for change
Personalized approach
Projects are tailor-made for your needs with room to pivot
Just another client
Revolving door of project managers who don't offer any personalization
Engaged, responsive team
Founders and project managers who embed into your team and champion your goals
Generalised MedTech Knowledge
Expertise may be lacking in medical device trials.
Deep, niche expertise
Medical device experts from trial design to data management

## Managed 140+ clinical trial projects

Mobius helps turn your innovation into standard care

CASE STUDY

### Revolutionising sperm selection with safer, stress-free technology

A new electrophoretic system offered a faster, safer alternative to conventional sperm selection. In
a multicentre pivotal trial, it outperformed Density Gradient Centrifugation, matched Swim-Up, and
showed no adverse events-supporting CE Mark submission.

[Read case study ->][19]
This is some text inside of a div block.
CASE STUDY

### Early feasibility to global pivotal trial for mitral valve innovation

An innovative repositionable mitral valve system underwent early feasibility trials in Australia
before scaling to a global pivotal study. Results showed durable valve function, improved survival,
and quality of life-culminating in CE Mark (2020) and FDA approval (2025).

[Read case study ->][20]
This is some text inside of a div block.
CASE STUDY

### Validating a non-invasive pain relief device for pregnancy

Pregnant women in their third trimester experienced better sleep and less pain using a specialised
maternity airbed tested in a Mobius-run pilot trial. The study validated safety, comfort, and
efficacy-proving a non-invasive way to ease late-pregnancy discomfort.

[Read case study ->][21]
This is some text inside of a div block.
"Mobius Medical have been a pleasure to work with. Their staff are reliable, they have solutions for
nearly every query and have a range of experience being able to support from conception through to
closeout."
"A great example of the new style of CROs - responsive, easy to work with, cost-effective,
collaborative and comprehensive in all their service offerings. We could not have chosen a better
partner for our investigative sites."
"The single most crucial attribute that Mobius Medical provides is their personnel. They have
staffed an incredibly skilful, competent and reliable team which is second to none. Enabling them to
execute exceptionally well as an organization."

## Global credibility, local *mastery*.

Clinical trials need to be built to scale. Our expertise ensures faster timelines, cost-effective
options, and data accepted by local regulators. whether scaling early studies from Australia to the
world, doing a pivotal study in the US or something in between - we transform your outcomes ensuring
success.
[About Mobius ->][22]

## Go from clinical trials to the market with us

Our ecosystem of partners extends your reach beyond clinical trials.

# Why Choose Newport Orthopedic Institute?

## Orthopedic Care You Can Trust

Newport Orthopedic Institute is the largest orthopedic and musculoskeletal group in coastal Orange
County serving Newport Beach, Huntington Beach, Irvine, and San Clemente. We provide a continuum of
care ranging from conservative treatment to surgical intervention in every area of orthopedic care.

The breadth of experience and expertise of 27 Board-certified or Board-eligible orthopedic surgeons,
sports medicine doctor, or physiatrists serves our patients well by providing a high level of
comprehensive care and service in every major orthopedic specialty.

Read More Read Less
[ Book Appointment ][110]
* **Comprehensive Muskuloskeletal Services**
  Our team is dedicated to providing multidisciplinary care for a wide range of orthopedic
  conditions. We target pain at its source to help you reach your full physical potential.
* **Over 30 Years of Orthopedic Care**
  We have been a trusted partner for pain management in Newport Beach and throughout coastal Orange
  County for over 30 years. We are committed to helping our community stay healthy and active.
* **A Member of the Community**
  Newport Orthopedic Institute is a pillar in the Newport Beach and Orange County communities,
  supporting local sporting clubs and participating in health-focused community events.

## Relief From Chronic Pain with Dr. Torres at Novus Spine & Pain Center

Bill describes his personal success story of finding relief from chronic back and leg pain with the
help of Dr. Torres at Novus Spine & Pain Center.

*“They told me point blank, ‘You’ve had this for quite some time. This is gonna be a tough thing to
go ahead and reverse completely, but we’re gonna eliminate the pain, if nothing else.’ And he has
done that.”
**-Bill*

One patient’s story in her own words about finding chronic pain relief from headaches and
complications with the help of Dr. Torres at Novus Spine & Pain Center.

*I thank Novus Spine & Pain Center for being there when I needed them the most. I’m now pain-free,
and I don’t have to take any more meds.
**-Jeanette*

# Lakeland, Florida Pain Management

[Pain Doctor in Lakeland, FL]

Pain management in Lakeland, Florida by Novus Spine & Pain Center, providing the highest quality
pain medicine to patients. Using a comprehensive approach and cutting edge therapies, we work
together to restore your function and regain your active lifestyle while minimizing the need for
opiates.

## Pain Management at Novus Spine & Pain Center

Dr. Torres specializes in **pain management in Lakeland, Florida**, and is certified in **Physical
Medicine and Rehabilitation and Pain Medicine** through the American Board of Physical Medicine and
Rehabilitation. Before founding Novus Spine, the premiere **pain clinic in Lakeland, Florida**, Dr.
Torres was at **Moffitt Cancer Center** in the Department of Neurology and Anesthesia. Today, Dr.
Torres continues to hold a clinical Assistant Professor appointment in the department of Physical
Medicine and Rehabilitation at the **University of South Florida **teaching Residents and Pain
Medicine Fellows.

# Advanced Pain Management Solution In The Woodlands

Pain MD Houston are experts in the latest and most comprehensive pain management treatment therapies
to help patients at all stages and with all types of complex, acute, and chronic pain.

[Dr. Mukalel][158] is dedicated to finding solutions for your pain syndromes. Having already
completed a fellowship in Acute Pain Medicine in Pittsburg, as well as having been the Director of
the University of Texas at Houston’s Orthopedic Anesthesia, Acute Pain Service and Fellowship in
Acute Pain and Regional Anesthesia as well as the Bayfront Health System’s Chief of Pain Medicine
and Obstetrical Anesthesia

## PAIN THERAPY

#### JUST.GOT.BETTER

In response to injury or inflammation, cells at the site of pain release a number of biochemical
mediators. It’s our job to pinpoint the root of those issues to provide the correct treatment
therapy for your unique issue.

Our nerves signal pain response to our brains and the most important thing your Interventional Pain
Physician can do is “get to the root of the problem”. Without a full understanding of your pain,
it’s virtually impossible to know which of the hundreds of treatment options are most likely to
provide a positive outcome.

Yes, treatments are individualized based on the specific needs and conditions of each patient,
ensuring effective pain management tailored to their circumstances.

Yes, Pain MD Houston specializes in minimally invasive procedures such as spinal cord stimulation

mediators. It’s our job to pinpoint the root of those issues to provide the correct treatment
therapy for your unique issue.

Our nerves signal pain response to our brains and the most important thing your Interventional Pain
Physician can do is “get to the root of the problem”. Without a full understanding of your pain,
it’s virtually impossible to know which of the hundreds of treatment options are most likely to
provide a positive outcome.

## About Dr. Tan

[Dr. Tan]

As the principal pain doctor in Singapore running The Pain Relief Clinic, Dr Terence Tan’s passion
for pain relief grew out of personal experience.

Having spent well over a decade treating patients suffering from pain, Dr Tan developed his special
interest by introducing non-invasive pain solutions and tissue repair technologies into Singapore.

He is accredited with both the Family Physician Accreditation Board and the Singapore Medical
Council.

He is also a member of the Singapore Medical Association and The Pain Association of Singapore.

Committed to providing result oriented pain treatments, his philosophy is to always offer patients
the safest, most effective and least invasive treatments available.

His patients appreciate the value of being able to have consultations, investigations (xray,
ultrasound and MRI), and treatments all done on the same day, especially when they are suffering
from severe pain.

Dr Tan’s clinical approach is that while there is a role for short term medications in specific
situations, patients do not generally want to be dependent on long term painkillers or try risky
solutions.

Even in age related, “wear and tear”, and other chronic conditions, a comprehensive yet targeted
approach to pain management can help patients be free from pain and lead a healthy active life.

## The Importance of Treating Pain Effectively:

Acute pain from recent injuries and other diseases can result in time off work, difficulty with
participation in sports, and interfere with other normal day activities.
Persistent pain from chronic injuries, wear and tear, nerve pain, and other causes often results in
frustration, low energy level, poor sleep (insomnia), irritability, depressed mood, difficulty with
concentration and memory, mobility problems and even reduced sexual function.
Relationships with friends and family, work, personal happiness and life in general may also be
affected. Pain has even been associated with loss of brain mass.

By properly treating persistent pain, patients will be able to enjoy work, sports, and life in
general more effectively.
Sleep will also become more restful, resulting in more energetic days and better moods.
More importantly, pain and its underlying cause must be properly treated to prevent it from getting
worse, and deteriorating to the point where surgery and other invasive treatments become necessary.
If you are unsure of the cause for the aches, pain or stiffness you are suffering from, or if your
condition has not improved despite standard treatments and have been told to consider surgery, do
not worry.
Simply contact us to explore your options.

## What To Expect When I Visit The Pain Relief Clinic

A typical visit will involve our doctor first understanding your medical history, concerns and
previous experience with other pain treatments.

For patients who have consulted many people but have yet to receive a clear diagnosis, selecting an
affordable imaging scan might be recommended to confirm the cause of your pain..

Some patients have already done scans with other doctors for their pain condition but are still not
clearly told what they suffer from.

Dr Terence Tan is happy to offer you a second opinion and recommend how best to manage your
condition.

We also see patients who already have a confirmed diagnosis from specialist pain doctors, but are
"stuck” because treatment options offered are not practical or acceptable.

We can help by discussing options that you might have potentially never been told of.

A common experience is when a patient has already consulted a specialist doctor for pain management
and is told to consider orthopaedic surgery which they find too aggressive.

Or they may have seen doctors for their pain and were prescribed painkillers with potential side
effects which made them feel uncomfortable.

Many of our patients have also first tried complementary treatments or acupuncture with traditional
Chinese pain doctors.

They look for a second opinion after finding any relief experienced from other treatments to be
temporary or requiring repetitive treatments, which add up to time and cost.

Especially in such situations, we emphasize using non-invasive medical technology you likely have
not been told about .

This can make a big difference to your results.

## About Dr. Tan

[Dr. Tan]

As the principal pain doctor in Singapore running The Pain Relief Clinic, Dr Terence Tan’s passion
for pain relief grew out of personal experience.

Having spent well over a decade treating patients suffering from pain, Dr Tan developed his special
interest by introducing non-invasive pain solutions and tissue repair technologies into Singapore.

He is accredited with both the Family Physician Accreditation Board and the Singapore Medical
Council.

He is also a member of the Singapore Medical Association and The Pain Association of Singapore.

Committed to providing result oriented pain treatments, his philosophy is to always offer patients
the safest, most effective and least invasive treatments available.

His patients appreciate the value of being able to have consultations, investigations (xray,
ultrasound and MRI), and treatments all done on the same day, especially when they are suffering
from severe pain.

Dr Tan’s clinical approach is that while there is a role for short term medications in specific
situations, patients do not generally want to be dependent on long term painkillers or try risky
solutions.

Even in age related, “wear and tear”, and other chronic conditions, a comprehensive yet targeted
approach to pain management can help patients be free from pain and lead a healthy active life.

[
**Book an Appointment**
][42]

## The Importance of Treating Pain Effectively:

Acute pain from recent injuries and other diseases can result in time off work, difficulty with
participation in sports, and interfere with other normal day activities.
Persistent pain from chronic injuries, wear and tear, nerve pain, and other causes often results in
frustration, low energy level, poor sleep (insomnia), irritability, depressed mood, difficulty with
concentration and memory, mobility problems and even reduced sexual function.
Relationships with friends and family, work, personal happiness and life in general may also be
affected. Pain has even been associated with loss of brain mass.

By properly treating persistent pain, patients will be able to enjoy work, sports, and life in
general more effectively.
Sleep will also become more restful, resulting in more energetic days and better moods.
More importantly, pain and its underlying cause must be properly treated to prevent it from getting
worse, and deteriorating to the point where surgery and other invasive treatments become necessary.
If you are unsure of the cause for the aches, pain or stiffness you are suffering from, or if your
condition has not improved despite standard treatments and have been told to consider surgery, do
not worry.
Simply contact us to explore your options.

## What To Expect When I Visit The Pain Relief Clinic

A typical visit will involve our doctor first understanding your medical history, concerns and
previous experience with other pain treatments.

For patients who have consulted many people but have yet to receive a clear diagnosis, selecting an
affordable imaging scan might be recommended to confirm the cause of your pain..

Some patients have already done scans with other doctors for their pain condition but are still not
clearly told what they suffer from.

Dr Terence Tan is happy to offer you a second opinion and recommend how best to manage your
condition.

We also see patients who already have a confirmed diagnosis from specialist pain doctors, but are
"stuck” because treatment options offered are not practical or acceptable.

We can help by discussing options that you might have potentially never been told of.

A common experience is when a patient has already consulted a specialist doctor for pain management
and is told to consider orthopaedic surgery which they find too aggressive.

Or they may have seen doctors for their pain and were prescribed painkillers with potential side
effects which made them feel uncomfortable.

Many of our patients have also first tried complementary treatments or acupuncture with traditional
Chinese pain doctors.

They look for a second opinion after finding any relief experienced from other treatments to be
temporary or requiring repetitive treatments, which add up to time and cost.

Especially in such situations, we emphasize using non-invasive medical technology you likely have
not been told about .

This can make a big difference to your results.

## Ask Dr Tan a Question about your problem

Are you suffering from Pain?
Tell us about your condition and we will help find your best treatment options.
My Question

 

Find out how your pain can be more effectively treated.

For enquiries, Call [+65 6732 2397][43]

## THE PAIN RELIEF CLINIC

**HOW IT ALL BEGAN**
The Pain Relief Clinic started providing non-invasive medical therapy in 2007. Our brand of
cost-effective pain treatments combines traditional techniques with new medical technology to
achieve fast and long lasting results. We have since grown into an international medical group of
doctors and physiotherapists with clinics in Singapore, Surabaya and Jakarta.

Singaporeans, permanent residents, and some international patients may be eligible for cashless
services.

This can remove the need to pay cash upfront, solving a potential problem even for patients with
insurance coverage.

You should be focused on getting answers and starting correct treatment, not worrying about large
upfront bills.

## Welcome to Southern Pain and Spine

Pain is personal. Our goal is to understand your pain and develop a customized treatment plan to
relieve your pain and get you back to the life you love.

Our board certified physicians and advanced practice providers take a comprehensive and
rehabilitative approach to pain and offer a wide range of interventional and minimally invasive
surgical treatments to heal chronic pain. 

At Southern Pain and Spine, we are pleased to bring a premier level of minimally-invasive spine and
joint pain care to metro Atlanta, North Georgia, and beyond. If you’re ready to take the first step
toward reducing pain and improving function, we’re here to help.

### Georgia’s Most Trusted Rehabilitation & Back Pain Specialists

## Welcome to Southern Pain and Spine

Pain is personal. Our goal is to understand your pain and develop a customized treatment plan to
relieve your pain and get you back to the life you love.

Our board certified physicians and advanced practice providers take a comprehensive and
rehabilitative approach to pain and offer a wide range of interventional and minimally invasive
surgical treatments to heal chronic pain. 

At Southern Pain and Spine, we are pleased to bring a premier level of minimally-invasive spine and
joint pain care to metro Atlanta, North Georgia, and beyond. If you’re ready to take the first step
toward reducing pain and improving function, we’re here to help.

infrastructure getting collapsed for non covid patients they had very less time to take care of a a
Parkinson patient who became severely malnourished due to lack of eating. I was also sure that with
some TLC I could help her back to a healthy state. This needed a true and trusted partner. That's
what I found in Sunburst heath care headed by Dr Sujata. She was extremely empathetic and provided a
day time nurse who worked along side a full time house help and a regular physiotherapist to nurse
my mom back to a healthy state with in months. We had the service from Dr Sujata continuously for 17
months. Dr Sujata also helped us get regular Dr visits for both our aging parents. We would have
continued the service had it not been for the reasons that instead of a nurse my mom needed a
companion to speak to in her native (non-Marathi) language. I would definitely re-engage Sunburst,
if there is need in the future.

In Oct 2021, when my mom was brought home, after Dr had given up on her life expectancy of not more
than 2 months. I was on the war path of making sure that the dr was wrong. Due to the whole medical
infrastructure getting collapsed for non covid patients they had very less time to take care of a a
Parkinson patient who became severely malnourished due to lack of eating. I was also sure that with
some TLC I could help her back to a healthy state. This needed a true and trusted partner. That's
what I found in Sunburst heath care headed by Dr Sujata. She was extremely empathetic and provided a
day time nurse who worked along side a full time house help and a regular physiotherapist to nurse
my mom back to a healthy state with in months. We had the service from Dr Sujata continuously for 17
months. Dr Sujata also helped us get regular Dr visits for both our aging parents. We would have
continued the service had it not been for the reasons that instead of a nurse my mom needed a
companion to speak to in her native (non-Marathi) language. I would definitely re-engage Sunburst,
if there is need in the future.

## Multidisciplinary care for people living with chronic pain

At the Pain Collective, we provide multidisciplinary pain management services through a network of
clinics across South Africa.

Our interdisciplinary team of doctors and therapists utilises therapy, medication, patient-centred
modalities, and interventional procedures as part of pain management.

Our approach emphasises active, patient -centred care and interventional strategies where
appropriate.

As part of our commitment to transparency and ongoing quality improvement, we routinely collect
anonymous patient experience feedback and publish summary results from our monthly internal service
evaluation surveys.

satisfied with their overall experience at our clinics.
